name: Timon
title: One of the Seven Deacons
summary: Timon was one of the seven men chosen by the early church in Jerusalem to serve at the tables and ensure the fair distribution of food to widows. He was selected because of his good reputation, and because he was full of the Spirit and wisdom.

keyEvents.title: The Selection of the Seven Deacons
keyEvents.description: Timon was chosen along with six other men to serve at the tables, so that the apostles could devote themselves to prayer and the ministry of the word. The church chose them because they had a good reputation and were full of the Spirit and wisdom.

keyEvents.title: Ordination by the Apostles' Laying on of Hands
keyEvents.description: The seven chosen ones, including Timon, were presented before the apostles who prayed and laid their hands on them, thereby confirming their service in the church.
